# Sensear

> Sensear designs smart industrial communication headsets and earplugs with dual hearing protection and SENS® Technology for high-noise workplace environments.

Sensear specializes in hearing protection solutions that combine noise reduction with digital communication capabilities for industrial, construction, aviation, and data center workers. Their products integrate with two-way radios and Bluetooth connectivity while meeting OSHA and NIOSH compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- SENS® Technology
- Hearing Protection
- Industrial Headsets
- High-Noise Environments
- Noise Reduction & Suppression
- SM1R Series
- smartPlug® Series
- Two-Way Radio Integration
- Bluetooth Connectivity
- Workplace Safety
- OSHA/NIOSH Compliance
- Speech Enhancement
- Dual Hearing Protection
- Industrial Communication
- Noise-Canceling Technology

## Product Lines

- [Smart Industrial Headsets | Sensear](https://www.sensear.com/industrial-headsets): Sensear SM1R industrial headsets for high-noise communication and safety
- [Smart Industrial Earplugs | Sensear](https://www.sensear.com/industrial-earplugs): Sensear smartPlug® series in-ear hearing protection with 31 dB noise reduction
- [Extreme Noise Headsets | Sensear](https://www.sensear.com/products/dual-hearing-protection-noise-cancelling-communication-headsets): Sensear dual hearing protection extreme noise headsets with SENS® Technology
